description: This file implements the HpackEntryTypeDecoder class for decoding HPACK header representations in HTTP/2, including methods for debugging and starting the decoding process based on input buffer data.

classes.name: HpackEntryTypeDecoder
classes.description: A class responsible for decoding HPACK entry types in HTTP/2 header compression, including methods for starting decoding and generating debug strings.

methods.name: HpackEntryTypeDecoder::DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the decoder's current state for debugging.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const HpackEntryTypeDecoder&)
methods.description: Overloads the stream insertion operator to output the debug string of the decoder.

methods.name: HpackEntryTypeDecoder::Start
methods.description: Begins decoding an HPACK entry type from the provided DecodeBuffer, determining the type based on the first byte and initializing the varint decoder accordingly.
